$comment: The MariaDB series every database gate runs against. One source of truth: scripts/test/run-integration.mjs,
scripts/checkpoint-verify.mjs and .github/workflows/ci.yml all read it, so a series can never be re-pinned
in one place and forgotten in another. That happened once already: HOST-001 found the plan on 11.8 and the
CI matrix moved, but checkpoint-verify.mjs kept testing 11.4 until Stage 6.
CI pins the digest as well (supply chain); the architecture suite asserts the workflow matrix matches this file.

series.why: The feature set ADR-014 targets. Nothing deploys on it; it catches use of anything newer.
The series the Hostinger plan runs (HOST-001, 2026-09-20: MariaDB 11.8.9).
